10                 Even as the nation is mourning the 

11    loss of jazz great Sonny Rollins, I am here to

13                 This resolution commemorates the 

14    50th anniversary of the National Black Caucus of 

15    State Legislators.  Founded in 1977 by 

16    approximately 18 visionary lawmakers, the 

17    National Black Caucus of State Legislators was 

18    established to address the pressing needs of 

19    Black constituents and to counter barriers to 

20    full participation within traditional legislative 

21    organizations.  

22                 NBCSL has grown into a premier 

23    bipartisan nonprofit membership organization 

24    representing more than 700 African-American state 

25    legislators from across the United States, 


                                                                5256

 1    collectively giving voice to over 50 million 

 2    African-Americans.  

 3                 NBCSL is dedicated to promoting 

 4    educational, research and training initiatives 

 5    that equip its members to make informed decisions 

 6    on legislation and public policy affecting 

 7    Black communities and other underserved 

 8    populations.

 9                 Through its commitment to fostering 

10    collaboration, advancing model legislation, and 

11    encouraging the exchange of ideas and 

12    information, NBCSL legislators serve as a dynamic 

13    force for public policy innovation and effective 

14    governance.

15                 The organization operates as a 

16    strong and unified advocate for African-American 

17    state legislators and their constituents at the 

18    federal level and state level, while also 

19    strengthening the effectiveness of its members 

20    within their respective states.

21                 As the national vice president of 

22    the National Black Caucus of State Legislators, I 

23    am proud to join my colleagues in New York and 

24    throughout the nation who have contributed 

25    meaningfully to the mission and work of NBCSL, 


                                                                5257

 1    advancing policies that promote equity, justice 

 2    and opportunity for all New Yorkers.

 3                 The 50th anniversary of the 

 4    National Black Caucus of State Legislators marks 

 5    a significant milestone in its enduring legacy of 

 6    bipartisanship, legislation, advocacy, and

 8    the lives of African-Americans and underserved 

 9    communities nationwide.

10                 Never has it been more necessary for 

11    this organization to be in existence than the 

12    days that we find ourselves in.  And we look 

13    forward to working with this Legislature and 

14    legislators throughout the nation to improve this 

15    country.
